`sample_orders.csv` holds 312 real order lines (44 invoices, 30 Sep to 30 Oct 2026) picked to cover
the edge cases: a store renamed mid-month, a store with missing address details, return invoices,
the same item twice on one invoice, and items whose description gained a "USE CODE" note.

Source: Iowa Department of Revenue, Alcohol Operations Bureau. Iowa Liquor Sales, Past 30 Days
[Dataset]. Iowa Data Hub, https://data.iowa.gov/catalog/dataset/1075. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
